operating_notes.text: Order book remains steady at around $1.0 to $1.2 billion.
Agchem exports declined ~12% with volume down 8% in Q1FY27 on soft global demand, while domestic volume rose ~12% with revenue up ~3%.
PIHS CRDMO revenue fell 25% YoY to ₹54.2 Cr in Q1FY27 on customer order phasing, with 4 marquee customers onboarded.
Net working capital days fell to 120 in Jun-26 from 139 in Mar-26, a 19-day reduction.

timeline.summary: Mayank Singhal, Promoter, declared no encumbrance on PI Industries’ equity shares held by Promoters or Promoter Group for FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.
PI Industries Limited’s **Ratnakar Joshi** and **Shruti Joshi** scheduled an Analysts/Investors Conference Call on May 20, 2026, at 03:00 PM (IST) for Q4 FY26 results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,565.2 Cr (-12.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹159.6 Cr.
PI Industries Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call on May 20, 2026, discussing audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
PI Industries hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, highlighting the upcoming launch of its first in-house NCE Pioxaniliprole and FY27 growth outlook.
PI Industries incorporated PI Foundation as a wholly owned subsidiary under Section 8 for CSR activities.
